reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount, but recomputes the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts.

duplication.why: The tolerance formula Math.round(Math.abs(n) * 0.075) is duplicated from getApproxNumberThreshold, and each caller repeats the same four-argument call with placeholder false/'nearest'.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the worst-case rule for ranges already is; callers stay in their layers.

scope.why: Only the amount helper, its server callers and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule only applies when callers remember to pass the op as a fourth positional argument after an unused rounding placeholder; client callers (SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit) and schedule-template still call without it, so the approximate rule silently diverges by call site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getScheduledAmount re-derives the approximate tolerance instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts).

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is copied verbatim from getApproxNumberThreshold, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The rule is defined in getScheduledAmount but is opt-in via amountOp; desktop-client callers (SchedulesTable.tsx, Balance.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx, MobileSchedulesPage.tsx, useScheduleEdit.ts) and budget/schedule-template.ts do not pass it, so those paths still use the exact value.
